# Project: SecondSelf MVP Launch
Deadline: End of Month
Core Goals:
- Ship Milestone 1 (Archivist CLI capture) and Milestone 2 (Groq PARA classification).
- Keep production serverless bundle below 50 MB on Vercel.
- Achieve sub-1.5s latency on /api/ask queries.
Key Blockers: Tuning cosine similarity threshold to avoid graph over-clustering.
